scheduleFunction.description: Schedules a function to execute at a specific mission time, with optional repetition if the function returns a future time value.

params.name: functionToCall
params.description: Function to be executed at the scheduled time.

params.name: anyFunctionArguement
params.description: Parameters to pass to the scheduled function.

params.name: modelTime
params.description: Mission time in seconds when the function should execute.

examples.description: The following will run a function named "main" 120 seconds from one the code would run.
The following example sets up a repetitive call loop where function CheckStatus is called every 5 seconds or.
examples.code:
function CheckStatus(ourArgument, time)
 -- Do things to check, use ourArgument (which is the scheduleFunction's second argument)
 if ourArgument == 53 and someExternalCondition then
   -- Keep going
   return time + 5
 else
   -- That's it we're done looping
   return nil
 end
end
timer.scheduleFunction(CheckStatus, 53, timer.getTime() + 5)

examples.description: This function will check if any red coalition units are in a trigger zone named "anyReds" and will set the flag "zoneOccupied" to true. This function will schedule itself to run every 60 seconds.
examples.code:
local function checkZone(zoneName)
   timer.scheduleFunction(checkZone, zoneName, timer.getTime() + 60)
   local zone = trigger.misc.getZone(zoneName)
   local groups = coalition.getGroups(1)
   local count = 0 
   for i = 1, #groups do
      local units = groups[i]:getUnits()
      for j = 1, #units do
          local unitPos = units[j]:getpoint()
           if math.sqrt((zone.point.x - unitPos.x)^2 + (zone.point.z - unitPos.z)^2) < zone.radius then
               count = count + 1
           end
      end
   end
   if count > 0 then
       trigger.action.setUserFlag("zoneOccupied", true)
   else 
      trigger.action.setUserFlag("zoneOccupied", false)
   end
 end
 checkZone("anyReds")

isVisible.description:

Note: This only tests terrain collision - buildings and other objects are not considered.
When working with ground objects, offset the Y-value (height) to prevent false negatives from the origin point clipping into terrain.

params.description: Starting point of the line-of-sight check.

params.name: destination
params.description: Ending point of the line-of-sight check.

Note: When using railroad paths, the parameter value should be `'rails'` (not `'railroads'`).

params.name: roadType

UNIT_CALLSIGN.description: Constant string identifier for accessing a unit's callsign property.

UNIT_HIDDEN.description: Constant string identifier for accessing a unit's visibility status in the Mission Editor.

UNIT_COALITION.description: Constant string identifier for accessing a unit's coalition affiliation (e.g., 'blue', 'red', 'unknown').

UNIT_COUNTRY_ID.description: Constant string identifier for accessing a unit's country ID property.

UNIT_TASK.description: Constant string identifier for accessing a unit's group task property.

UNIT_PLAYER_NAME.description: Constant string identifier for accessing the player name controlling a unit, applicable only to player-controllable units.

UNIT_ROLE.description: Constant string identifier for accessing a unit's role property (e.g., 'artillery_commander', 'instructor').

UNIT_INVISIBLE_MAP_ICON.description: Constant string identifier for accessing a unit's map icon visibility status in the Mission Editor.

getCurrentMission.description: Returns a table representing the current mission data structure as stored in the mission file.

setPause.description: Pauses or resumes the simulation, affecting all connected clients in multiplayer.

params.name: action
params.description: `true` to pause the simulation, `false` to resume it.

getPause.description: Returns a `boolean` indicating whether the simulation is currently paused.

stopMission.description: Terminates the current mission and returns to the mission selection screen.

exitProcess.description: Closes the DCS World application completely, terminating all processes.

isMultiplayer.description: Returns `true` if the current simulation is in multiplayer mode, `false` if in single-player mode.

isServer.description: Returns `true` if the current instance is running as a dedicated server or single player host, `false` otherwise.

getModelTime.description: Returns a `number` representing the total simulation time in seconds since the DCS application was launched.

getRealTime.description: Returns a `number` representing the elapsed time in seconds since the current mission started.

getMissionOptions.description: Returns a table containing the mission options as stored in the options.lua file within the mission package.

getAvailableCoalitions.description: Returns a map-like table where keys are coalition IDs and values are tables containing information about coalitions with available player slots.

getAvailableSlots.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of tables containing information about player slots available in the specified coalition.

params.name: coaId
params.description: Coalition identifier (numeric ID or string name).

getAvailableSlots.returnValueExample: array of {unitId, type, role, callsign, groupName, country}

getAvailableSlotsAll.description: Returns a table containing information about all player-controllable slots available in the current mission.

coalition.description: Provides functions for managing faction-based entities in the DCS World environment, including unit information retrieval, group spawning, and static object creation.

addGroup.description: Adds a new group to the mission for the specified coalition and country, returning a `function` that can be called to complete the spawn process.

params.name: groupData
params.description: Table defining the group configuration to be spawned.

add_dyn_group.description: Adds a dynamic (runtime-created) group to the mission for the specified coalition and country, returning a `function` that finalizes the spawn process.

params.name: groupData
params.description: Table defining the dynamic group configuration to be spawned.

remove_dyn_group.description: Removes a previously added dynamic group from the mission, returning `true` if successful.

params.name: groupName
params.description: Name of the dynamic group to remove from the mission.

addStaticObject.description: Adds a new static object to the mission for the specified country, returning a `StaticObject`. The coalition is automatically determined from the country identifier.

params.name: country
params.description: Country identifier that determines which coalition the static object will belong to.

params.name: staticData
params.description: Table defining the static object configuration to be spawned.

getGroups.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of `Group` objects belonging to the specified coalition and country.

getStaticObjects.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of `StaticObject` objects belonging to the specified coalition and country.

getAirbases.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of `Airbase` objects belonging to the specified coalition and country.

getPlayers.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of `Unit` objects representing player-controlled units in the specified coalition.

getServiceProviders.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of `Unit` objects providing the specified service type within the coalition.

params.name: service
params.description: Service type enumeration value (e.g., ATC, AWACS, TANKER, FAC).

addRefPoint.description: Adds a reference point for the specified coalition, returning a `function` that finalizes the addition.

params.name: refPoint
params.description: Table defining the reference point to be added.

getRefPoints.description: Returns a table of reference points defined for the specified coalition.

getMainRefPoint.description: Returns a table representing the primary reference point for the specified coalition.

getCountryCoalition.description: Returns a `number` representing the coalition identifier that the specified country belongs to.

checkChooseCargo.description: Returns `true` if cargo selection is possible for the specified unit within the coalition.

params.name: unitId
params.description: Unique identifier of the unit to check.

checkDescent.description: Returns `true` if a descent operation (e.g., paratrooper drop) is possible for the specified unit.

params.name: unitId
params.description: Unique identifier of the unit to check.

getAllDescents.description: Returns a table of all available descent operations (e.g., paratroopers, cargo) for the specified coalition.

getDescentsOnBoard.description: Returns a table of all descent operations (e.g., paratroopers, cargo) currently loaded on the specified unit.

params.name: unitId
params.description: Unique identifier of the unit to query.

side.description: Provides access to the coalition side enumerator for faction identification.

service.description: Provides access to the service type enumerator for communications services.

NEUTRAL.description: Neutral coalition, value 0. Same value as `coalition.side.NEUTRAL`.

RED.description: Red coalition, value 1. Same value as `coalition.side.RED`.

BLUE.description: Blue coalition, value 2. Same value as `coalition.side.BLUE`.

atmosphere.description: Provides functions for querying atmospheric conditions in the DCS World environment, including wind, temperature, and pressure data.

getWind.description: Returns a `Vec3` representing the wind velocity vector at the specified position in the DCS World coordinate system.

getWindWithTurbulence.description: Returns a `Vec3` representing the wind velocity vector with turbulence effects at the specified position in the DCS World coordinate system.

getTemperatureAndPressure.description: Returns two `number` values representing the temperature (in Kelvins) and pressure (in Pascals) at the specified position in the DCS World coordinate system.

missionCommands.description: Provides functions for creating and managing interactive menu commands in the F10 radio menu.

addCommand.description: Adds an interactive command to the F10 radio menu for all players that executes a specified Lua function when selected.

params.name: name
params.description: Display text for the menu command.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to parent menu as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, command is added to root menu.

params.name: functionToRun
params.description: Function to execute when command is selected.

params.name: anyArguement
params.description: Optional value passed to `functionToRun` when executed.

addSubMenu.description: Creates a submenu in the F10 radio menu for all players, which can contain additional commands or nested submenus.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to parent menu as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, submenu is added to root menu.

removeItem.description: Removes a menu item or entire submenu from the F10 radio menu for all players.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the menu item as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, removes all items.

addCommandForCoalition.description: Adds an interactive command to the F10 radio menu for players of a specific coalition.

params.name: name
params.description: Display text for the menu command.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to parent menu as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, command is added to root menu.

params.name: functionToRun
params.description: Function to execute when command is selected.

params.name: anyArguement
params.description: Optional value passed to `functionToRun` when executed.

addSubMenuForCoalition.description: Creates a submenu in the F10 radio menu for players of a specific coalition.

params.name: coalitionSide
params.description: Target coalition as a `coalition.side` enum value.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to parent menu as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, submenu is added to root menu.

removeItemForCoalition.description: Removes a menu item or entire submenu from the F10 radio menu for a specific coalition.

params.name: coalitionSide
params.description: Target coalition as a `coalition.side` enum value.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the menu item as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, removes all items for the coalition.

addCommandForGroup.description: Adds an interactive command to the F10 radio menu for players in a specific group.

params.name: name
params.description: Display text for the menu command.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to parent menu as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, command is added to root menu.

params.name: functionToRun
params.description: Function to execute when command is selected.

params.name: anyArguement
params.description: Optional value passed to `functionToRun` when executed.

addSubMenuForGroup.description: Creates a submenu in the F10 radio menu for players in a specific group.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to parent menu as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, submenu is added to root menu.

removeItemForGroup.description: Removes a menu item or entire submenu from the F10 radio menu for a specific group.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the menu item as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, removes all items for the group.

doAction.description: Executes a radio menu action programmatically without user interaction.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the menu command as a sequence table of menu names.

Unit.description: Represents a unit entity in the DCS World, including airplanes, helicopters, vehicles, ships, and armed ground structures.

getByName.description: Returns a `Unit` object with the specified name, or `nil` if not found. Provides access to both activated and non-activated units.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the unit as defined in the mission editor or mission.

getDescByName.description: Returns a table containing detailed description of the specified unit type. The exact type of descriptor returned depends on the unit's category: AIRPLANE units return UnitDescAirplane, HELICOPTER units return UnitDescHelicopter, GROUND_UNIT units return UnitDescVehicle, SHIP units return UnitDescShip, and other types return the base UnitDesc. Functions even for unit types not present in the current mission.

params.name: typeName
params.description: Internal type name of the unit, e.g. 'FA-18C_hornet'.

getDescByName.returns: UnitDesc | UnitDescAircraft | UnitDescAirplane | UnitDescHelicopter | UnitDescVehicle | UnitDescShip

getTypeName.description: Returns the unit's type name as defined in the DCS database.

isActive.description: Returns `true` if the unit is activated in the mission, `false` otherwise.

isAlive.description: Present in DCS 2.9.29. Signature probed (DCS 2.9.29.27468): no arguments besides self; returns from one call; accepts an extra argument.

isBroken.description: Present in DCS 2.9.29. Signature probed (DCS 2.9.29.27468): no arguments besides self; returns from one call; accepts an extra argument.

isDead.description: Present in DCS 2.9.29. Signature probed (DCS 2.9.29.27468): no arguments besides self; returns from one call; accepts an extra argument.

isEffective.description: Present in DCS 2.9.29. Signature probed (DCS 2.9.29.27468): no arguments besides self; returns from one call; accepts an extra argument.

getPlayerName.description: Returns the `string` name of the player controlling this unit, or `nil` if AI-controlled.

getID.description: Returns the `number` representing the unique mission ID of the unit.

getNumber.description: Returns the `number` representing the index of the unit within its group. This index persists even as other units in the group are destroyed.

getCategoryEx.description: Returns a `Unit.Category` enumerator representing the specific category of the unit.

getObjectID.description: Returns the `number` representing the runtime object ID of the unit. Every simulation object has a unique objectID.

getController.description: Returns the `Controller` object for this unit. Note: Ships and ground units are only controllable at a group level.

getGroup.description: Returns the `Group` object that this unit belongs to.

getCallsign.description: Returns a `string` representing the localized callsign of the unit.

getLife.description: Returns a `number` representing the current hit points of the unit. Values below 1 indicate the unit is destroyed.

getLife0.description: Returns a `number` representing the maximum hit points of the unit. This value never changes during a mission.

getFuel.description: Returns a `number` representing the remaining fuel percentage (0.0 to 1.0+). Values above 1.0 indicate external fuel tanks.

getAmmo.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of ammunition data for all weapons loaded on the unit.

getSensors.description: Returns a numerically indexed table containing all sensors available on the unit.

hasSensors.description: Returns `true` if the unit has the specified sensor type and subcategory, `false` otherwise.

params.name: sensorType
params.description: Type of sensor to check for.

params.name: subCategory
params.description: Subcategory of the sensor type to check for.

getRadar.description: Returns information about the unit's radar status: operational state and tracked object (if any).

getDrawArgumentValue.description: Returns a `number` representing the current value of a specified animation parameter on the unit's 3D model.

params.name: arg
params.description: The argument number for the animation parameter.

getNearestCargos.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of nearby friendly cargo objects sorted by distance, or `nil` if not applicable.

enableEmission.description: Enables or disables the unit's emissions, affecting radar and other detectable systems without changing AI state.

params.name: setting
params.description: True to enable emissions, false to disable.

getDescentCapacity.description: Returns a `number` representing the infantry capacity of an aircraft, or `nil` for non-aircraft units.

getDesc.description: Returns a table containing detailed technical specifications of the unit. The exact type of descriptor returned depends on the unit's category: AIRPLANE units return UnitDescAirplane, HELICOPTER units return UnitDescHelicopter, GROUND_UNIT units return UnitDescVehicle, SHIP units return UnitDescShip, and other types return the base UnitDesc.
getDesc.returns: UnitDesc | UnitDescAircraft | UnitDescAirplane | UnitDescHelicopter | UnitDescVehicle | UnitDescShip

getAirbase.description: Returns the `Airbase` object where the unit is stationed or landed, or `nil` if not at an airbase.

canShipLanding.description: Returns `true` if the unit can land on a ship, `false` otherwise.

checkOpenRamp.description: Returns `true` if the unit's ramp is currently open, `false` otherwise.

disembarking.description: Initiates the disembarkation process for troops or cargo from this transport unit.

getCargosOnBoard.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of cargo objects currently loaded on the unit.

getCoalition.description: Returns a `coalition.side` enumerator representing the unit's coalition alignment.

getCommunicator.description: Returns the communication system object for this unit.

getCountry.description: Returns a `country.id` enumerator representing the unit's country affiliation.

getDescentOnBoard.description: Returns information about troops currently loaded on the unit.

getForcesName.description: Returns a `string` name of the military force this unit belongs to, or `nil` if not specified.

getFuelLowState.description: Returns a `number` representing the low fuel threshold for this unit, or `nil` if not applicable.

getNearestCargosForAircraft.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of nearby cargo objects suitable for aircraft loading, or `nil` if not applicable.

getSeats.description: Returns information about available seating in the unit.

hasCarrier.description: Returns `true` if the unit is or has aircraft carrier capabilities, `false` otherwise.

LoadOnBoard.description: Loads specified cargo or troops onto this transport unit.

markDisembarkingTask.description: Marks a task for disembarking troops or cargo from this unit.

OldCarrierMenuShow.description: Displays the legacy carrier operations menu for this unit.

openRamp.description: Opens the cargo ramp on this transport unit to allow loading/unloading.

UnloadCargo.description: Initiates the unloading process for cargo carried by this unit.

vtolableLA.description: Returns `true` if the unit has VTOL landing capabilities, `false` otherwise.

Position3.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing both position and orientation in the DCS World coordinate system.

p.description: A `Vec3` representing the object's position in the DCS World coordinate system.

x.description: A normalized `Vec3` representing the object's forward direction vector in the DCS World coordinate system.

y.description: A normalized `Vec3` representing the object's upward direction vector in the DCS World coordinate system.

z.description: A normalized `Vec3` representing the object's rightward direction vector in the DCS World coordinate system.

LatLon.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing geographical coordinates using latitude and longitude values.

lat.description: Latitude value in decimal degrees, with positive values representing north of the equator and negative values representing south.

lon.description: Longitude value in decimal degrees, with positive values representing east of the prime meridian and negative values representing west.

StaticObjectDesc.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a static object's properties and physical characteristics in the DCS World.

life.description: A numeric value representing the initial health or integrity level of the static object.

box.description: A box (two Vec3 points) representing the three-dimensional collision boundaries of the static object in the DCS World coordinate system.

StaticObjectSpawnData.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing spawn parameters for a static object used with coalition.addStaticObject.

name.description: A string identifier for the static object.

type.description: A string specifying the classification or model type of the static object.

x.description: X coordinate of the static object's position in the DCS World coordinate system.

y.description: Y coordinate of the static object's position in the DCS World coordinate system.

heading.description: Orientation angle in radians representing the static object's heading in the DCS World.

category.description: A string specifying the functional category of the static object.

dead.description: Controls whether the static object spawns in a destroyed state.

shape_name.description: A string identifying the 3D model resource used to render the static object.

rate.description: A numeric value controlling the visual appearance rate, typically set to 100.

canCargo.description: Controls whether the static object can be loaded as cargo.

mass.description: A numeric value specifying the object's mass in kilograms.

Zone.description: Trigger zone used in mission editor and referenced in zone-related events.

name.description: Name of the zone as defined in the mission editor.

radius.description: Radius of the zone in meters.

coalition.description: The `coalition.side` value indicating which faction owns or controls the zone, or `nil` if not coalition-specific.

Cargo.description: Base cargo object used in cargo-related events.

mass.description: Mass of the cargo in kilograms.

position.description: A `Vec3` representing the cargo's current position in the DCS World coordinate system.

displayName.description: The human-readable name of the cargo shown in mission interfaces and logs.

DynamicCargo.description: Dynamic cargo object that can be moved during mission.

id.description: Unique identifier of the dynamic cargo.

type.description: The type classification of cargo, determining its visual model and behavior properties.

mass.description: Mass of the dynamic cargo in kilograms.

Callsigns_JTAC.description: Enumerator for Joint Terminal Attack Controller (JTAC) callsigns, used to identify JTAC units in communications and mission planning.

unknown.description: Represents a value whose type is not strictly defined or may vary across different contexts in the DCS World scripting environment.

ColorRGBA.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a color with red, green, blue, and alpha components, each normalized between 0.0 and 1.0.

r.description: Red component value between 0.0 (no red) and 1.0 (maximum red intensity).

g.description: Green component value between 0.0 (no green) and 1.0 (maximum green intensity).

b.description: Blue component value between 0.0 (no blue) and 1.0 (maximum blue intensity).

a.description: Alpha (transparency) component value between 0.0 (fully transparent) and 1.0 (fully opaque).

VoiceChat.Side.description: Enumerator for coalition sides, used to define which players have access to specific voice chat rooms.

VoiceChat.RoomType.description: Enumerator for voice chat room categories, used to specify the behavior and persistence of communication channels. Note: Only PERSISTENT (0) is reliable for scripted room creation.

VoiceChat.RadioHandlers.description: Enumerator for radio control properties, used to access and modify aircraft radio communication settings through the VoiceChat API.

VoiceChat.RadioHandlersSingletons.description: Enumerator for intercom system properties, used to access and modify aircraft internal communication settings through the VoiceChat API.

Vec2.description: Represents a 2D vector or point, typically used for map coordinates in the DCS World coordinate system. It is a Lua table with `x` and `y` keys.

x.description: X coordinate, which represents the north-south direction in the DCS World coordinate system. North is positive, South is negative.

y.description: Y coordinate, which represents the east-west direction in the DCS World coordinate system. East is positive, West is negative.

Vec2Array.description: Represents a numerically indexed Lua table (sequence) of `Vec2` points in the DCS World coordinate system.

RefPoint.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a reference point used by Joint Terminal Attack Controllers (JTACs) and other mission elements for targeting and navigation.

callsign.description: A string identifier serving as the callsign or designation for the reference point.

type.description: A numeric identifier categorizing the reference point's purpose or classification.

point.description: A `Vec3` representing the precise 3D position of the reference point in the DCS World coordinate system.

TriggerZoneCircular.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a circular area used for spatial trigger conditions in the DCS World.

position.description: A `Position3` representing the center point and orientation of the trigger zone in the DCS World coordinate system.

radius.description: A numeric value defining the radius of the circular trigger zone in meters.

AirbaseArray.description: Represents a numerically indexed Lua table (sequence) of `Airbase` objects in the DCS World mission.

Vec3.description: Represents a 3D vector or point, typically used for positions or velocities in the DCS World coordinate system. It is a Lua table with `x`, `y`, and `z` keys.

x.description: X coordinate, which represents the north-south direction in the DCS World coordinate system. North is positive, South is negative.

y.description: Y coordinate, which represents the elevation direction in the DCS World coordinate system. Up is positive, Down is negative.

z.description: Z coordinate, which represents the east-west direction in the DCS World coordinate system. East is positive, West is negative.

Vec3Array.description: Represents a numerically indexed Lua table (sequence) of `Vec3` points in the DCS World coordinate system.

EventData.description: Event data structure that contains information about an event. The id field identifies which type of event is being handled.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

target.description: The target object involved in the event (present in hit, kill, shooting events).

weapon.description: The weapon used during the event (present in shot, hit, kill events).

WeaponName.description: Name of the weapon (present in weapon_add events).

place.description: The place object (used in landing, takeoff, birth, base_captured events).

subplace.description: The specific location within the place (used in birth events).

MarkID.description: ID of the mark in mark-related events.

Zone.description: The zone object in trigger zone events.

Cargo.description: The cargo object in cargo-related events.

IniPlayerName.description: Name of the player that initiated the event.

TgtPlayerName.description: Name of the player that was targeted.

EventHandlerTable.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an event handler object that can be registered with world.addEventHandler.

onEvent.description: Function that handles simulator events when they occur. Called with (self, event) parameters where event is of type EventData.

EventDataBase.description: Base structure for all event data. Contains common fields present in every event.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

EventDataShot.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_SHOT events. Occurs whenever any unit fires a weapon.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

EventDataHit.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_HIT events. Occurs whenever an object is hit by a weapon.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

weapon.description: The weapon that hit the target. May be nil in multiplayer due to desync issues.

EventDataTakeoff.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_TAKEOFF events. Occurs when an aircraft takes off.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

place.description: The airbase or ship from which the takeoff occurred.

EventDataLand.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_LAND events. Occurs when an aircraft lands.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

place.description: The airbase or ship where the landing occurred.

EventDataBaseCaptured.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_BASE_CAPTURED events. Occurs when a base is captured.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

EventDataBirth.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_BIRTH events. Occurs when an object is spawned.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

place.description: The place where the unit was spawned, if applicable.

subplace.description: The specific location type within the place where the unit was spawned.

EventDataKill.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_KILL events. Occurs when a unit kills another unit.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

weapon.description: The weapon that caused the kill, if applicable.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

MarkID.description: ID of the mark that was added, changed, or removed.

EventDataShootingStart.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_SHOOTING_START events. Occurs when continuous shooting begins.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

target.description: The target being shot at, if applicable.

EventDataWeaponAdd.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_WEAPON_ADD events. Occurs when a weapon is added to a unit.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

WeaponName.description: Name of the weapon that was added.

EventDataGeneric.description: Event data structure containing all possible fields from any event type.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

IniObjectCategory.description: (UNIT/STATIC/SCENERY) The initiator object category (Object.Category.UNIT or Object.Category.STATIC).

IniDCSUnit.description: (UNIT/STATIC) The initiating DCS Unit or StaticObject.

IniUnit.description: (UNIT) The initiating MOOSE Unit wrapper of the initiator Unit object.

IniUnitName.description: (UNIT) The initiating UNIT name (same as IniDCSUnitName).

IniGroupName.description: (UNIT) The initiating GROUP name (same as IniDCSGroupName).

IniTypeName.description: (UNIT) The type name of the initiator.

IniPlayerName.description: (UNIT) The name of the initiating player in case the Unit is a client or player slot.

IniPlayerUCID.description: (UNIT) The UCID of the initiating player in case the Unit is a client or player slot.

target.description: (UNIT/STATIC) The target object (Unit/StaticObject/other depending on event type).

TgtObjectCategory.description: (UNIT/STATIC) The target object category (Object.Category.UNIT or Object.Category.STATIC).

TgtDCSUnit.description: (UNIT/STATIC) The target DCS Unit or StaticObject.

TgtUnitName.description: (UNIT) The target UNIT name (same as TgtDCSUnitName).

TgtGroupName.description: (UNIT) The target GROUP name (same as TgtDCSGroupName).

TgtTypeName.description: (UNIT) The type name of the target.

TgtPlayerName.description: (UNIT) The name of the target player in case the Unit is a client or player slot.

TgtPlayerUCID.description: (UNIT) The UCID of the target player in case the Unit is a client or player slot.

weapon.description: The weapon used during the event (present in shot, hit, kill events).

WeaponPlayerName.description: Player name associated with the weapon, if applicable.

WeaponUNIT.description: Sometimes, the weapon is a player unit.

place.description: The place object (used in landing, takeoff, birth, base_captured events).
