Entity.Airbase.description: A terrain airdrome. Static fields come from the terrain's `Radio.lua` and `Beacons.lua`, linked by their `airfield<N>_<k>` ids. Name, category, reference point, magnetic variation, runways and stands exist only at runtime (`terrain.cfg.lua` is encrypted): they come from the per-terrain runtime pass (`world.getAirbases()` joined by id to the terrain config's `Airdromes`) and are absent for terrains it has not run on.

airdromeId.description: DCS airdrome id N (`Airbase:getID()`; a mission's `airdromeId`).

name.description: Optional DCS airbase name (`Airbase:getName()`); runtime only.

categoryName.description: Optional `Airbase.Category` key of `category` (for example `AIRDROME`); runtime only.

referencePoint.description: Optional aerodrome reference point: the terrain config's `reference_point`; its `elevationM` is the field elevation. Runtime only.

magneticVariation.description: Optional magnetic variation at the reference point, as DCS computes it for 1 January of the DCS build year; runtime only.

longestRunwayM.description: Optional `lengthM` of the longest runway, metres; from `runways`.

services.description: Optional ATC services, one per `Radio.lua` entry.

Entity.AirbaseService.description: One `Radio.lua` ATC radio of an airbase: its roles, call signs per faction and frequencies.

serviceTypes.description: Communication type code of each role, index for index (`GND`, `TWR`, `APP`); hand-authored mapping.

channels.description: Optional frequencies, one per band (DCS lists none for some airbases).

Entity.RadioCallsign.description: An ATC call sign for one faction.

Entity.RadioChannel.description: One frequency of an ATC service.

Entity.MagneticVariation.description: Magnetic variation (declination) from DCS's own `magvar` (`magvar.init(month, year)`, `magvar.get_mag_decl(lat, lon)`); date-dependent, so recorded with its reference date.

date.description: Fixed reference date it was computed for, `YYYY-MM` (the month and year passed to DCS `magvar.init`).

source.description: DCS function that produced it (for example `magvar.get_mag_decl`).

Entity.Runway.description: A physical runway: a `Terrain.getRunwayList` entry with its edge points, paired with the `Airbase:getRunways()` entry on its axis. Lengths in metres, bearings in degrees.

designator.description: Designator pair of the directions, lower number first (for example `13L/31R`).

lengthM.description: Length, metres: straight-line distance between the runway list entry's two edge points, which are the runway spawn points at each end. Shorter than the runway drawn in the mission editor by a varying amount (about 200 m at Beirut, 826 m on Creech 08/26), so not a takeoff or landing distance.

Entity.RunwayDirection.description: One landing direction of a runway, with its threshold. Its `threshold` is the runway list's edge point DCS names `edge<k>name` (`edge<k>`), the runway spawn point at that end; the true bearing runs from it to the other edge.

designator.description: End designator: `name`, zero-padded to two digits, when its number is within 3 of round(`magneticBearingDeg` / 10) (0 becomes 36, wrapping 36 to 01; published names lag the drifting variation), otherwise that geometric number with DCS's L/C/R suffix if any. Runways whose axes lie within 5 degrees are parallel; a suffixless end sharing its number with another runway of its group is suffixed L/R or L/C/R by lateral position among the runways sharing it (collinear segments within 50 m share a letter), left to right along the direction of travel (in groups of more than three the whole designator comes from geometry: sets of two or three, larger first, numbered N, N+1, ... from the group's mean magnetic bearing).

name.description: DCS's own name for this end, verbatim: of the runway list entry's `edge1name`/`edge2name`, the one whose number better matches this direction's magnetic bearing (DCS sometimes gives them the other way round).

designatorMismatch.description: Optional; true when `name`, zero-padded to two digits, differs from `designator` (a number more than 3 off the geometry, a duplicated or missing end name, or an ambiguous name among parallel runways).

trueBearingDeg.description: True bearing, degrees: great-circle bearing from the threshold to the other edge (their `coord.LOtoLL`; map x is grid north, not true north).

magneticBearingDeg.description: Magnetic bearing, degrees: `trueBearingDeg` minus the airbase `magneticVariation`.

threshold.description: The runway spawn point at this end (the runway list edge point), not the painted threshold; `elevationM` is the ground elevation there.

tdzeM.description: Optional touchdown zone elevation, metres: highest `land.getHeight` sample (every 10 m or less along the centreline) within 914.4 m (3000 ft) of `threshold`.

navaids.description: Optional `Entity.Navaid` ids serving this direction (localizer `direction` + 180 within 10 degrees of the direction's map-grid bearing).

Entity.AircraftStand.description: A parking stand: an `Airbase:getParking()` spot joined to its `Terrain.getStandList` stand (by `Term_Index` = `crossroad_index`, else by position within 2 m), with the size limits the mission editor checks when placing aircraft; or, when it joins no listed stand, a runway take-off position (`runwayEnd`).

name.description: Optional DCS stand name, verbatim (`getStandList` `name`; the mission's `parking_id`); absent when no listed stand joins the spot.

termType.description: DCS `Term_Type` (DCS defines no names for its values).

limits.description: Size and use limits (`getStandList` `params`); present on every spot joined to a listed stand; absent on runway-end spots (`runwayEnd`), which no DCS source gives limits.

runwayEnd.description: Optional designator (`Entity.RunwayDirection` `designator`) of the runway threshold this spot lies on (within 2 m): a DCS runway take-off position (`Term_Type` 16 in DCS 2.9.29, one per runway end), not a parking stand; it has no `name` and no `limits`. Every spot that joins no listed stand is one.

Entity.StandLimits.description: A stand's limits as the mission editor reads them (`Terrain.getStandList` params). The editor (`me_parking.getRightParkingAirport`) accepts an aircraft when its `wingSpanM` (else `rotorDiameterM`) < `maxWidthM`, `lengthM` < `maxLengthM` and `heightM` < `maxHeightM` (1000 when absent), and `helicopters` (for a helicopter) or `airplanes` (for a plane) is true (`Entity.AircraftDimensions`).

maxWidthM.description: `WIDTH`, metres (compared with wing span / rotor diameter).

Entity.Country.description: A country in the DCS database (`db.Countries`).

shortName.description: Optional short name (`ShortName`), as used by livery `description.lua` files.

troops.description: Optional `Troops` (squadrons and units), in DCS order.

pictureRect.description: `pictureRect`: the rank's rectangle in `stripes`, four numbers as DCS gives them.

Entity.StationForbidden.description: A launcher entry's `forbidden` rule, normalised: while this store is on this station, station `station` must not hold any of `clsids`, or must be empty with `anyStore`. Exactly one of `clsids` and `anyStore` is present.

clsids.description: Optional `loadout`: the store CLSIDs it must not hold, DCS order.

anyStore.description: Optional; true when DCS gives no `loadout`: the station must hold no store.

Entity.StationRequired.description: A launcher entry's `required` rule, normalised: while this store is on this station, station `station` must hold one of `clsids`, or be empty when `allowEmpty`.

clsids.description: `loadout` without `""`: the store CLSIDs it may hold, DCS order (empty when DCS lists only `""`).

allowEmpty.description: True when `loadout` lists `""`, DCS's empty station (the mission editor clears the station to meet the rule).

Entity.StationStore.description: A store a station accepts, with the launcher entry's loadout rules (entries of one CLSID merged). The mission editor applies them when the store is loaded: `forbidden` stations are cleared of the listed stores (of any store with `anyStore`), `required` stations get the first listed CLSID unless they hold one (cleared when that is `""`).

Entity.Station.description: A weapon or store station (pylon) on an aircraft entity: every `Pylons` entry, as the mission editor lists them.

station.description: `Number`: station (pylon) index as numbered by the module.

type.description: Optional `Type`, the raw DCS pylon type (0, 1 or 2; 2 on internal bays and smoke stations, among others). DCS names none, and the mission editor offers a station's launchers whatever its type (MissionEditor/modules/me_loadoututils.lua `getPylonsNames`, `getPylonLaunchers`), as `fitStores` does.

displayName.description: Optional `DisplayName`, the mission editor's column label (default: the column's position).

order.description: Optional `Order`, the mission editor's column order (default: `station`).

wet.description: True if the station accepts a store whose launcher `category` is fuel tank.

position.description: Optional mounting offset of the station on the airframe; absent when the pylon lacks any of `X`/`Y`/`Z`.

accepts.description: Stores that can be mounted on this station, by CLSID.

obsoleteAccepts.description: Optional launcher entries DCS marks `obsolete = true` (every entry of the CLSID), which the mission editor hides (MissionEditor/modules/me_loadoututils.lua `getPylonLaunchers`): stores the station no longer accepts, by CLSID. `stationsAccepting`, `canMount`, `fitStores`, `loadoutMass` and the `carriers` index (`aircraftCarrying`, `launchPlatforms`) read only `accepts`.

_source.description: Optional provenance map keyed by field path (for example `position.lateral: corrected`, a per-airframe sign correction from tools/datamine/overlays.yaml). Absent fields are datamined.

Entity.FuzeParameter.description: One `SchemeFuzeParameters` value; exactly one of `number`, `numbers` and `flag` is set.

mode.description: Optional fuze mode table the value sits in (`ED`, `SAD`, `TDD`).

Entity.FuzeType.description: A fuze or fuze scheme of the weapon GUI tables (`FuzeDescriptions`, `SchemeFuzeParameters`).

parameters.description: Optional `SchemeFuzeParameters` values, by mode and name.

Entity.WeaponRequirement.description: One requirement of a `depends_on_unit` alternative, as DCS writes it: `{"self", n}` (`selfWs`), `{"none"}` (`none`), `{unit}` or `{unit, n}` (`unit`, `ws`).

unit.description: Optional cross-reference: the unit type required (any unit series).

ws.description: Optional number DCS gives after `unit`, raw.

selfWs.description: Optional weapon-system index (`WS[n]`) on the same unit.

Entity.WeaponRequirementSet.description: One `depends_on_unit` alternative: requirements that together enable the launcher.

Entity.AngleSector.description: One traverse sector of `WS[i].angles` exactly as DCS stores it, radians.

Entity.WeaponPayload.description: One payload (`WS[i].LN[j].PL[k]`) of a launcher. Each field is absent when DCS does not define it.

weapon.description: Optional cross-reference: the `Entity.Weapon` id of `type_ammunition` (the projectile named in wsType slot 4, or a `weapons.*` resource name); absent when it does not resolve.

ammoCapacity.description: Optional `ammo_capacity`: rounds or missiles in this payload.

Entity.SlewRate.description: Turret slew rates of a weapon system, radians per second.

Entity.WeaponSystem.description: One launcher (`WS[i].LN[j]`) of a ground vehicle or ship, whether it fires (has `PL` payloads) or is a tracking channel. Fields come from the unit's effective (template-inherited) launcher data; each is absent when DCS does not define it.

weapons.description: Optional cross-reference: the payloads' `weapon` ids (unique, sorted).

gunAmmo.description: Optional cross-reference: the payloads' `gunAmmo` ids (unique, sorted).

payloads.description: Optional payloads, in `PL` order; absent for a launcher without `PL`.

rMinKm.description: Optional minimum engagement range in kilometres (launcher `distanceMin`, else the weapon system's).

rMaxKm.description: Optional maximum engagement range in kilometres (launcher `distanceMax`, else the weapon system's).

hMinM.description: Optional minimum target altitude in metres (`min_trg_alt`).

hMaxM.description: Optional maximum target altitude in metres (`max_trg_alt`).

missileChannels.description: Optional `max_number_of_missiles_channels` (or DCS's other spelling `max_number_of_missile_channels`; both set and different is an extraction error).

dependsOn.description: Optional `depends_on_unit`: alternatives, each a list of requirements that together enable the launcher. Absent (and reported at extraction) when DCS writes it in another shape.

frequencyRangeHz.description: Optional `frequencyRange` `[min, max]` as DCS gives it; hertz by DCS convention, though a few DCS entries hold values that are not (e.g. `[14.2, 14.8]`).

maxShootingSpeed.description: Optional `maxShootingSpeed`, the raw DCS value (unit not stated by DCS).

sectorsRad.description: Optional `WS[i].angles`: the traverse sectors exactly as DCS stores them, radians.

Entity.FireControl.description: The named (non-indexed) fields of a unit's `WS` table.

radarType.description: Optional `WS.radar_type`, the raw DCS number (a value outside `Entity.UnitRadarType` is kept as is).

radarTypeName.description: Optional `Entity.UnitRadarType` constant name of `radarType` (absent when no single constant carries it).

Entity.SurfaceDimensions.description: Hull or chassis size and mass: a ground vehicle's `chassis.length`/`width`/`mass`, a ship's `Length`/`Width`/`Height`/`mass`.

enginePower.description: Optional `chassis.engine_power`, the raw DCS value (DCS files disagree on its unit).

minTurnRadiusM.description: Optional `R_min`, minimum turn radius in metres.

economyDistance.description: Optional `economy_distance`, raw (metres by their values: 74080000 = 40000 NM on the Nimitz class).

Entity.ArmourRow.description: One `armour_scheme` row `[fromDeg, toDeg, factor]` as DCS gives it.

Entity.ArmourScheme.description: `armour_scheme`: per hull/turret aspect, rows `[fromDeg, toDeg, factor]` as DCS gives them.

Entity.UnitArmour.description: Armour of a ground vehicle or ship.

thickness.description: Optional `chassis.armour_thickness`, the raw DCS value (unit not stated by DCS).

Entity.CarrierOls.description: `OLS` optical landing system of a ship.

Entity.GlidePath.description: The six glide-path values of a `RunWays` entry, named as the DCS carrier files' comment names them; raw DCS values.

Entity.CarrierRunway.description: One `RunWays[i]` entry of a ship, laid out as the DCS carrier files' comment gives it (`VppStartPoint, azimuth (degree), Length_Vpp, Width_Vpp, alsArgument, <glide path>`); the first entry is the landing strip.

start.description: Start point `{x, y, z}` in the ship's model frame, metres.

Entity.UnitFacilities.description: Navigation aids, landing facilities and parking a ship (or other surface unit) provides.

tacanPosition.description: Optional `TACAN_position` `{x, y, z}` in the ship's model frame, metres.

iclsLocalizerPosition.description: Optional `ICLS_Localizer_position`: `{x, y, z}` in the model frame, metres, then a fourth value, raw.

iclsGlideslopePosition.description: Optional `ICLS_Glideslope_position`: `{x, y, z}` in the model frame, metres, then a fourth value, raw.

landingPoint.description: Optional `Landing_Point` `{x, y, z}` in the model frame, metres.

arrestingGears.description: Optional `ArrestingGears`, in DCS order (their count is `ArrestingGearsNumber`, checked).

taxiRoutes.description: Optional `TaxiRoutes`, in DCS order (their count is `RoutesNumber`, checked).

helicopterSpawnTerminals.description: Optional `HelicopterSpawnTerminal` entries, in DCS order (their count is `TerminalNumber`, checked).

Entity.ArrestingGear.description: One `ArrestingGears` wire: each end is a model connector or a position.

leftPosition.description: Optional `Left.pos` `{x, y, z}`, model frame, metres.

rightPosition.description: Optional `Right.pos` `{x, y, z}`, model frame, metres.

Entity.PathPoint.description: One `{{x, y, z}, n, ...}` point of a ship route.

position.description: `{x, y, z}` in the model frame, metres (a few DCS points add a fourth value, kept raw).

values.description: The numbers after the position, raw.

Entity.GroundVehicle.description: A ground vehicle type. Cross-references to sensors and weapons are string ids.

natoReportingName.description: Optional NATO reporting name DCS gives the unit: the double-quoted part of an `Air Defence` unit's `displayName` (`SA-11 Buk "Gadfly" LN` -> `Gadfly`), whether it names the whole system (`Gadfly`, `Grumble`) or the unit itself (`Flat Face`, `Fan Song`); hand-authored in tools/datamine/overlays.yaml (`_source`) where DCS quotes none, or quotes the system's name on a part NATO names on its own (the S-300PS and Buk radars: `Flap Lid A`, `Fire Dome`). Quotes on other units (nicknames such as `Jimmy`) are not taken.

tags.description: Optional `tags` (for example `Air Defence`, `SAM SHORAD`), in DCS order.

sensors.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Sensor` ids fitted to this vehicle.

weapons.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Weapon` ids carried by this vehicle.

life.description: Optional life values, one per DCS field that sets one (they are on different scales).

fireControl.description: Optional named fields of the unit's `WS` table.

facilities.description: Optional navigation aids, landing facilities and parking.

weaponSystems.description: Optional launchers (`WS[i].LN[j]`), in DCS `WS` then `LN` order.

operators.description: Optional countries that operate this vehicle and their service-year ranges.

_source.description: Provenance map keyed by field path: `natoReportingName` is `hand-authored` when it comes from tools/datamine/overlays.yaml. Absent fields are datamined.

Entity.Personnel.description: A personnel type: infantry or crew figure (`db.Units.Personnel`).

sensors.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Sensor` ids fitted to this unit.

life.description: Optional life values, one per DCS field that sets one (they are on different scales).

operators.description: Optional countries that field this unit and their service-year ranges.

Entity.Ship.description: A ship type. Cross-references to sensors and weapons are string ids.

natoReportingName.description: Optional NATO reporting name DCS gives the unit: the double-quoted part of an `Air Defence` unit's `displayName` (`SA-11 Buk "Gadfly" LN` -> `Gadfly`), whether it names the whole system (`Gadfly`, `Grumble`) or the unit itself (`Flat Face`, `Fan Song`); hand-authored in tools/datamine/overlays.yaml (`_source`) where DCS quotes none, or quotes the system's name on a part NATO names on its own (the S-300PS and Buk radars: `Flap Lid A`, `Fire Dome`). Quotes on other units (nicknames such as `Jimmy`) are not taken.

sensors.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Sensor` ids fitted to this ship.

weapons.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Weapon` ids carried by this ship.

life.description: Optional life values, one per DCS field that sets one (they are on different scales).

fireControl.description: Optional named fields of the unit's `WS` table.

facilities.description: Optional navigation aids, landing facilities and parking.

weaponSystems.description: Optional launchers (`WS[i].LN[j]`), in DCS `WS` then `LN` order.

operators.description: Optional countries that operate this ship and their service-year ranges.

_source.description: Provenance map keyed by field path: `natoReportingName` is `hand-authored` when it comes from tools/datamine/overlays.yaml. Absent fields are datamined.

Entity.Structure.description: A static structure (buildings, fortifications and other scenery objects), usually without sensors or weapons.

sensors.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Sensor` ids fitted to this structure.

weapons.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Weapon` ids carried by this structure.

life.description: Optional life values, one per DCS field that sets one (they are on different scales).

facilities.description: Optional navigation aids, landing facilities and parking.

operators.description: Optional countries that operate this structure and their service-year ranges.

Entity.CallsignCategory.description: The callsigns of one `db.Callnames` category for a country.

category.description: Category key: a unit attribute (`Air`, `AWACS`, `Tankers`, ...) or a unit type.

country.description: Country whose `db.Callnames` list this is: the record's own, else its `fallbackCountry`.

Entity.CountryCallsigns.description: A country's callsigns as the mission editor resolves them (`db.Callnames`, `db.DefaultCountry`).

numeric.description: True when `db.callnamesRussia` lists the country: the mission generator gives it numeric (red) callsigns.

fallbackCountry.description: Country whose lists fill categories the country lacks: `db.DefaultCountry[country]`, else USA (MissionEditor callsign.lua `getCallnames`).

categories.description: Every category of the country or its fallback, by name.

Entity.SensorKind.description: Class of a sensor entity, from the constant names of its `category` and, for optics, its `type`. `unknown` when those fields are absent or unrecognised.

Entity.Sensor.description: A sensor: optic, radar, IRST or RWR.

categoryName.description: Optional DCS constant name of `category` (for example `SENSOR_OPTICAL`).

type.description: Optional sensor `type`: an `Entity.OpticSensorType` for optical sensors, an `Entity.RadarType` for radars.

typeName.description: Optional DCS constant name of `type` (for example `OPTIC_SENSOR_IR`).

detectionRangeKm.description: Optional nominal detection range in kilometres: `max_measuring_distance`, else (IRST) the largest `irstDetectionDistance`; absent for sensors with neither (optics, RWRs).

detectionRangeField.description: Optional DCS field `detectionRangeKm` was read from: `max_measuring_distance` or `detection_distance_for_tail_on_Su_27`.

trackWhileScan.description: Optional; true if the sensor can track while scanning.

attributes.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Attribute` ids describing this sensor.

rcs.description: Optional `RCS`: the reference target of `detectionDistance`, raw.

pods.description: Optional `DisplayName`s of the `db.Pods` entries that carry this sensor (their `Name` is redacted in dumps).

Entity.SensorVolume.description: A `{azimuth, elevation}` volume of a sensor: `[min, max]` each, degrees.

Entity.RadarDetectionDistance.description: `detection_distance[hemisphere][aspect]` of a radar, metres; the keys are HEMISPHERE_UPPER/LOWER and ASPECT_HEAD_ON/TAIL_ON as the install's sensor scripts define them (tools/datamine/extract_sensors.py SENSOR_KEY_FILES).

Entity.IrstDetectionDistance.description: `detection_distance_for_tail_on_Su_27[engine mode]` of an IRST, metres; the keys are the ENGINE_MODE_* constants the install's sensor scripts define.

Entity.DatalinkType.description: Datalink standard implemented by a datalink entity.

Entity.Datalink.description: The mission editor's datalink-page limits for a unit type, from the descriptor file its `datalinks` table names (run by tools/datamine/extract_datalink.py).

canBeLink16Donor.description: True if the unit type declares the `AddPropAircraft` property (`STN_L16`) the mission editor's Link16 pages offer donor and team-member units by.

supportsTeamMembers.description: True if the mission editor's datalink page has a team-member list (Link16, SADL: `network.teamMembers`; IDM: a preset's `network.presets[n].members`).

supportsCrossFlightTeam.description: True if that list accepts units of another group (flight).

maxDonors.description: Most units the page's `network.donors` list takes; 0 without a donor list.

maxTeamMembers.description: Most units the page's team-member list takes, the unit itself included.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes about the datalink implementation.

Entity.Provenance.description: Provenance of a batch of extracted entities: the DCS install and extractor that produced them.

dcsVersion.description: DCS World version the data was extracted from.

extractedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the extraction ran.

extractor.description: Name and version of the extractor that produced the data.

source.description: Source of the data (for example the _G self-dump).

constants.description: The DCS numeric constant families read from the dump's `__constants__.lua`.

modulesPresent.description: Names of the DCS plugins (`_origin`) that registered at least one extracted unit, projectile, or launcher record.

Entity.ConstantFamily.description: One family of DCS numeric constants captured in the `_G` dump.

count.description: Number of constants in the family.

Entity.Livery.description: A stock livery (skin) shipped in the DCS install for a given unit type.

entryPoint.description: The livery's folder name: the entry point DCS looks it up by (a unit's `livery_entry`, else its type, `/` as `_`; case-insensitive).

unitTypes.description: Cross-reference: unit type ids whose entry point this is; empty when it is no unit's (e.g. a weapon model's liveries).

name.description: Livery name as shown in the UI.

countries.description: Optional countries the livery is offered for: the `country.id` values whose `ShortName` its `description.lua` `countries` table lists (the Mission Editor matches liveries by `ShortName`). Absent when there is no such table: the livery is offered for every country. Present but empty when the table lists no known country (see `unmappedCountries`) or is `{}`: offered for none.

countryNames.description: Optional `country.id` constant names of `countries`, index for index; present exactly when `countries` is.

unmappedCountries.description: Optional strings of the `description.lua` `countries` table that are no country's `ShortName`, sorted, as written (typos, placeholders such as `XXX`); absent when every string maps.

module.description: Optional path of the owning module directory relative to `CoreMods` (for example `aircraft/F-16C`); absent for Bazar liveries.

path.description: Path of the livery's `description.lua` (or its folder when there is none), relative to the DCS install.

massKg.description: Optional mass per round in kilograms.

type.description: Optional ammunition type (for example HE, AP, API).

attributes.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Attribute` ids describing this ammunition.

Entity.RadioBand.description: Primary frequency band of a radio entity.

Entity.RadioSegment.description: One DCS `range` segment of a radio: a tunable frequency range and the modulation the mission editor gives it.

modulation.description: The segment's DCS `modulation`; else the `modulation` label (AM, FM) of the radio's preset channels inside it; else MODULATION_AM, the mission editor's fallback (MissionEditor/modules/me_panelRadio.lua `updateModulation`). MODULATION_AM_AND_FM means either.

defaultModulation.description: Optional DCS `modulationDef`: the modulation the mission editor selects on entering the segment.

editable.description: Optional `editable`: the mission editor lets the frequency be changed.

Entity.Radio.description: An aircraft or unit communications radio.

id.description: Unique radio identifier: `<aircraft>__radio<index>`, the DCS `panelRadio` index from 0.

name.description: Optional DCS `panelRadio` name (for example `UHF AM: ARC-164`); absent for a `HumanRadio`-only aircraft.

band.description: Primary frequency band of the radio: the one its DCS `name` names (UHF and VHF together are V/UHF); else from its tunable range by hand-authored band edges (`_source.band: hand-authored`).

range.description: Overall tunable frequency range in megahertz, lowest to highest `segments` bound.

segments.description: The DCS `range` segments, in DCS order; frequencies between them are not tunable.

stepKHz.description: Optional tuning step in kilohertz (hand-authored; VHF/UHF only).

guard.description: True if a tunable segment covers the band's emergency frequency (121.5 or 243 MHz); hand-authored.

modulationName.description: DCS constant names of `modulation`, index for index (for example `MODULATION_AM`).

_source.description: Provenance map keyed by field: `hand-authored` (tools/datamine/overlays.yaml) for `guard`, `stepKHz` and a `band` the radio's name does not name. Absent fields are datamined.

id.description: Unique warhead identifier; `<weapon>.cluster`/`<weapon>.cluster2` for a cluster's submunition warheads.

type.description: Optional warhead mechanism: `shaped-charge` (`cumulative_factor` > 0), `AP` (`piercing_mass` > 0 with explosive filler under half the mass) or `HE` (other explosive filler). Absent when the record has no charge to classify.

explosiveMassKg.description: Optional mass of high-explosive filler in kilograms.

fragmentation.description: Optional; true when the warhead carries explosive filler (`expl_mass` > 0). Not a DCS fragmentation-model flag.

hardTargetPenetrator.description: Optional DCS `is_htp`: hard-target penetrator warhead. Absent when DCS does not set it.

Entity.Beacon.description: One radio navigation transmitter from a terrain's `Beacons.lua`: VOR, DME, TACAN, NDB/homer, localizer, glidepath, RSBN, PRMG. Values are DCS's, verbatim.

id.description: `<theatre>.<beaconId>` (`beaconId` is unique only within a terrain).

displayName.description: Optional DCS `display_name`, a free label (not reliably the airbase name).

frequencyHz.description: Optional DCS `frequency`, hertz (for TACAN the DCS receiver frequency).

channel.description: Optional DCS `channel` (TACAN/DME/RSBN/PRMG channel number; TACAN X/Y mode is not given).

direction.description: DCS `direction`, degrees, verbatim (0 for omnidirectional equipment).

airbase.description: Optional `Entity.Airbase` id, when the `beaconId` is `airfield<N>_<k>` (airdrome N).

Entity.Theatre.description: A DCS terrain (map) from `Mods/terrains/<directory>/entry.lua`, with its map projection fitted to the terrain's beacons (or, without beacons, to the runtime pass's `coord.LOtoLL` grid).

projection.description: Optional map projection; absent when the terrain ships no geo-referenced beacons and has no runtime dump to fit it from.

datum.description: Optional WGS84 latitude/longitude of the map origin (x = 0, z = 0) through `projection`.

aliases.description: Optional other names the theatre goes by (e.g. `NTTR`), hand-authored in tools/datamine/overlays.yaml (`_source`); none repeats the id, displayName or directory, and no two theatres share one.

_source.description: Optional provenance map keyed by field path: `aliases` is `hand-authored`. Absent fields are datamined.

Entity.MapProjection.description: Transverse Mercator (WGS84, latitude of origin 0) mapping latitude/longitude to DCS map metres: z = falseEasting + k·E, x = falseNorthing + k·N. Least-squares fit to every beacon's `position` against its `positionGeo` (or to `coord.LOtoLL` on a 9 x 9 grid over the airdromes); parameters rounded to what 6-decimal `positionGeo` resolves.

latitudeOfOrigin.description: Degrees; fixed at 0 (it trades exactly against `falseNorthing`).

scaleFactor.description: Scale factor on the central meridian.

falseEasting.description: Metres added to the projected easting to give map z.

falseNorthing.description: Metres added to the projected northing to give map x.

Entity.ProjectionFit.description: Residuals of the projection fit, horizontal metres; extraction fails above 1 m or with fewer than 10 points spanning 50 km.

source.description: Optional `coord.LOtoLL` when fitted to the runtime grid; absent: the beacons.

spanKm.description: Largest distance between two of the points, kilometres.

Entity.GeoPoint.description: A WGS84 latitude/longitude in decimal degrees.

Entity.MapPosition.description: A DCS map (world) position in metres: `x` north, `y` up (altitude above MSL), `z` east of the map origin.

x.description: Metres north.

y.description: Metres up.

Entity.MapPoint.description: A surface point in map metres (`x` north, `z` east) with its WGS84 latitude/longitude and optional elevation.

x.description: Metres north.

elevationM.description: Optional terrain height at the point, metres above MSL (`land.getHeight`).

Entity.AircraftKind.description: Airframe locomotion class of an aircraft entity.

Entity.Gun.description: Internal gun armament of an aircraft entity.

type.description: Optional gun model identifier (the first gun's `short_name` or `display_name`).

ammo.description: Cross-reference: `Entity.GunAmmo` ids loadable in any of the guns, sorted.

rounds.description: Total round capacity of the guns.

mixes.description: Optional ammunition mixes the mission editor offers, DCS order: one per `ammo_type` label (stored as the 1-based `payload.ammo_type`); mix i of every `mounts` entry is its belt.

defaultMix.description: Optional `ammo_type_default`, 1-based index into `mixes` (the editor's default is 1 without it).

mounts.description: One entry per `Guns[]` gun, DCS order.

Entity.GunMix.description: One gun ammunition mix the mission editor offers.

Entity.GunMount.description: One gun of an aircraft (a `Guns[]` entry) and its ammunition supply.

rounds.description: Round capacity: `supply.count`, or `count1` + `count2` for a dual-feed gun.

ammo.description: Cross-reference: `Entity.GunAmmo` ids of `supply.shells` (else `shell1`, `shell2`), DCS order; `mixes` index them.

mixes.description: Optional `supply.mixes`, DCS order (one per `Entity.Gun.mixes` label when there are labels). Absent when the gun has none, or when an index names no shell (an upstream gap in tools/datamine/overlays.yaml).

Entity.GunBelt.description: One `supply.mixes` entry of a gun: its belt pattern.

ammo.description: Cross-reference: shell indices as `Entity.GunAmmo` ids, belt order, repeats kept.

Entity.AircraftDimensions.description: Airframe dimensions, metres, as the DCS unit database gives them (`wing_span`, `rotor_diameter`, `length`, `height`). The mission editor's stand fit (`Entity.StandLimits`) compares `wingSpanM` (else `rotorDiameterM`), `lengthM` and `heightM` with a stand's limits.

Entity.AircraftTask.description: A DCS task (`Tasks[i]`/`DefaultTask`) of an aircraft.

Entity.AircraftPerformance.description: AI flight-performance figures of an aircraft.

casMin.description: Optional `CAS_min`, raw (DCS comments call it both a speed in m/s and minutes).

Entity.AircraftOperations.description: Basing and equipment flags of an aircraft.

dateOfIntroduction.description: Optional `date_of_introduction`, raw (year with a fractional part).

Entity.AircraftFailure.description: One `Failures` entry the mission editor offers.

Entity.MissionOptionValue.description: One `values` entry of a combo-list mission option.

id.description: Optional `id`, the value the mission stores.

guiAction.description: Optional `guiAction` `{controls, onSelect}`: editor controls enabled or disabled on selection.

Entity.MissionOption.description: One mission-editor special option (`AddPropAircraft`/`AddPropVehicle` entry), stored in the mission unit's `AddPropAircraft`/`AddPropVehicle` by `id`. Layout fields (`wCtrl`, `xCtrl`, `wLbl`, `xLbl`) are left out; function fields are not in the dump.

arg.description: Optional `arg`, the model draw argument it sets.

forcedPylons.description: Optional `forcedPylons`: per option value, station -> CLSID forced on it.

isTanker.description: Optional `is_tanker` as DCS gives it (a boolean, a number in some DCS entries).

receptaclePosition.description: Optional `air_refuel_receptacle_pos` `{x, y, z}` in the airframe's model frame, metres.

Entity.Dispenser.description: One `chaff_flare_dispenser` entry, in the airframe's model frame.

Entity.AircraftCountermeasures.description: Chaff and flare load (`passivCounterm`) and dispensers (`chaff_flare_dispenser`).

dispensers.description: Optional dispensers, in DCS order; an entry that is not `{dir, pos}` is reported at extraction and left out.

Entity.Aircraft.description: A flyable or AI aircraft type. Cross-references are string ids.

id.description: Unique aircraft type identifier (DCS unit type name).

displayName.description: Human-readable aircraft name shown in the UI.

flyable.description: True if the aircraft can be flown by a human: a flyable plugin of the extracting DCS install declares it (`make_flyable`/`MAC_flyable` in a `Mods/*/*/entry.lua`), or the dump marks it `_file_flyable`. Reflects the modules installed where the data was extracted.

module.description: Optional DCS plugin that registered the aircraft (the unit's `_origin`, for example "A-10 Warthog"); absent for aircraft defined by the core game scripts.

attributes.description: Cross-reference: `Entity.Attribute` ids describing this aircraft's capabilities and classifications.

dimensions.description: Optional airframe dimensions from the unit's DCS database entry.

crew.description: Optional number of crew stations (`crew_size`, else the number of `crew_members`).

sensors.description: Cross-reference: `Entity.Sensor` ids fitted to this aircraft.

radios.description: Cross-reference: `Entity.Radio` ids fitted to this aircraft.

defaultRadio.description: Optional `HumanRadio`: the group radio the mission editor sets, AI aircraft included.

datalink.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Datalink` id fitted to this aircraft.

stations.description: Weapon and store stations (pylons) on this aircraft.

life.description: Optional life values, one per DCS field that sets one.

failures.description: Optional `Failures`, DCS order (empty when DCS's table is empty).

tasks.description: Optional `Tasks`, in DCS order (empty when DCS's table is empty).

countermeasures.description: Optional chaff and flare load and dispensers.

countryOfOrigin.description: Optional `country_of_origin` (or DCS's misspelling `country_of_orgin`), as DCS gives it (for example `USA`).

operators.description: Countries that operate this aircraft and their service-year ranges.

Entity.ActionParam.description: A parameter name of an action and where it was seen.

name.description: Key in the task's `params` (a command's or option's in `params.action.params`).

seenIn.description: `default` (the Mission Editor's default task), `declared` (`key = nil` in its `actionsData` entry), `makeParams` (returned by its `makeParams`), `panel` (`actionParams.<key>` in its parameter panels), `scripts` (a task table of DCS's own scripts), `missions` (install missions); empty for a parameter tools/datamine/overlays.yaml adds (the record's `_source` has `params[name=<name>]: hand-authored`).

types.description: Lua types of the default, script literal and mission values (empty when only named in the source).

missionCount.description: Optional number of install mission actions that set it.

missionStrings.description: Optional string values install missions set it to, most used first (only when at most 12 distinct).

Entity.ActionParamString.description: A string value install missions give a parameter.

Entity.ActionCapability.description: The Mission Editor's check that a group can take the action (`verifyGroupCapability`; `verifyUnitCapability` for statics).

rule.description: Optional name of the check function (absent for an inline function).

attributes.description: Optional unit attributes the check tests (`findAttribute`).

messages.description: Optional untranslated messages the check returns.

Entity.ActionMakeParams.description: The Mission Editor function that fills a new action's params from its group (`makeParams`).

rule.description: Optional function name (absent for an inline function).

Entity.ActionScript.description: A DCS script (`Scripts/`) passing the action's table to a controller.

file.description: Script path relative to the install (`Scripts/ScriptingSystem.lua`).

function.description: Optional named function making the call (`trigger.action.groupStopMoving`).

Entity.ActionAvailability.description: A group category and group task whose action list (`availableActions`) offers the action.

groupTask.description: Group task name (`Default` applies to tasks without their own list).

edPublicHidden.description: Optional; true when the list drops it while the global `ED_PUBLIC_AVAILABLE` is set.

Entity.ActionMissions.description: Where install missions use the action.

contexts.description: Occurrences per context: `route` (waypoint task) or `triggered` (group triggered action), then the wrappers it sits in (`>ComboTask`, `>ControlledTask`, `>WrappedAction`).

Entity.ActionManeuverParam.description: A parameter of an aerobatics maneuver (`AerobaticsManeuversData[...].param`).

Entity.ActionProbeResult.description: One id casing of an action in one context of the live actions probe (api/actions-probe.json).

context.description: `setTask`, `pushTask`, `comboTask`, `wrappedAction`, `setCommand`, `setOption` or `route` (a late-activated mission group's waypoint task).

category.description: Group category of the probed controller.

accepted.description: Optional; the call raised no Lua error (absent when not run).

effectObserved.description: Optional; the action's measured effect beat the control's (absent without an effect measure).

logLines.description: Optional number of dcs.log lines attributed to the call.

Entity.Action.description: A Mission Editor AI action (`me_action_db.actionsData`, `me_staticAction_db.actionsData`): task, en-route task, command or option; or a command only DCS's own scripts send (no `modules`).

id.description: `ActionId` name (`ORBIT`, `CAP`, `INVISIBLE`, `ROE`, ...); the DCS id of a command only DCS's scripts send (`StopRoute`).

modules.description: Mission Editor modules defining it (`me_action_db`, `me_staticAction_db`); empty for a command only DCS's scripts send.

dcsId.description: Task id as the Mission Editor writes it (a command's or option's `WrappedAction` action id).

key.description: Optional Mission Editor variant key of a shared `dcsId` (en-route `EngageTargets`: `CAP`, `CAS`, ...).

wrapped.description: Whether the Mission Editor stores it as a `WrappedAction` (false for a command only DCS's scripts send, unwrapped).

displayName.description: Untranslated display name; absent for a command only DCS's scripts send.

defaultParams.description: Params of the default task the Mission Editor creates; absent for a command only DCS's scripts send.

params.description: Every parameter name seen, by name.

availableFor.description: Group categories and tasks offering it.

probe.description: Optional live actions probe results of this DCS version (of `probedOn` when set).

probedOn.description: Optional DCS version the `probe` results were measured on, when this version has no actions probe of its own (the newest earlier version's).

_source.description: Optional provenance map keyed by field path (for example `params[name=point]: hand-authored`, a parameter added by tools/datamine/overlays.yaml). Absent fields are datamined.

Entity.ActionOptionValueSet.description: An option's allowed values (`optionValues`) for some group categories.

categories.description: Optional group categories (Mission Editor `optionValues` keys); absent when one set serves all.

values.description: Optional list of values, in DCS order.

units.description: Optional Mission Editor unit table of the value (`timeUnits`, `altitudeUnits`).

Entity.ActionOptionMissionValue.description: A value install missions set an option to.

value.description: Optional value; absent when missions leave it nil.

Entity.ActionOption.description: A Mission Editor AI option (`OptionName` of me_action_db.lua).

categories.description: Group categories whose option list offers it.

missionValues.description: Optional values install missions use, most used first.

Entity.Seeker.description: Seeker parameters DCS gives a weapon as plainly typed fields; each is absent when the weapon's record (and its same-name `_G/rockets` record) lacks it. Field-of-view angles are left out: the newer schemes give several seeker blocks with different `FOV`s.

generation.description: Optional `SeekerGen` (annotated `-- Seeker generation` in the install's weapon scripts).

cooled.description: Optional `SeekerCooled`, else the `cooled` flag of its `simple_IR_seeker`/`IR_seeker`/`sensor` block (they must agree).

irSensitivityRangeKm.description: Optional `SeekerSensivityDistance` in kilometres (annotated `-- The range of target with IR value = 1. In meters.` in the install's weapon scripts).

maxSeekerRangeKm.description: Optional `max_seeker_range` of its `seeker`/`laser_seeker`/`laser_spot_seeker`/`sensor` block, in kilometres (the blocks must agree).

Entity.ClusterElement.description: One block of a cluster's `client` table that carries a `count` (bomblets, dispenser parts, skeets...).

submunition.description: `name`: the submunition's DCS name (not an `Entity.Weapon` id).

count.description: Optional submunition count: `count` of the `bomblets` block, else of the `cluster` block; absent when neither exists (see `elements`).

elements.description: Every counted block, sorted by name.

warhead.description: Optional cross-reference: the `Entity.Warhead` of the block's `client.warhead` (one submunition's), id `<weapon>.cluster`.

timeS.description: `delay_time`, seconds (DCS's weapon scripts: delay is enabled for all bombs by default; the vane default is calibrated to 0.8 s).

velK.description: `velK`, raw (DCS's weapon scripts: 0.00834 arms in 0.8 s at 150 m/s release speed).

Entity.Weapon.description: A weapon (projectile record). Cross-references are string ids.

id.description: Unique weapon identifier: the projectile record's `name`.

category.description: Optional wsType level 2 of `ws_type`/`wsTypeOfWeapon` when level 1 is wsType_Weapon. A record without a wsType takes it from the launchers that deliver it exactly (slot 4) when they all agree (`_source.category: launcher`); failing both, a record defined in DCS's own `bombs` table is wsType_Bomb (`_source.category: table`; every `bombs` record carrying a wsType is wsType_Weapon/wsType_Bomb, asserted at extraction); absent otherwise.

categoryName.description: Optional DCS constant name of `category` (for example `wsType_Missile`).

launcherCategory.description: Optional top-level `category` of the projectile record.

launcherCategoryName.description: Optional DCS constant name of `launcherCategory` (for example `CAT_AIR_TO_AIR`).

warhead.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Warhead` id fitted to this weapon: the `warhead` (else `client.warhead`) with a `mass` of the weapon's own record, else of a same-name projectile record defining the same DCS object (equal `_unique_resource_name`, else equal `ws_type`), with `_source.warhead: <dir>` (e.g. `bombs`). A cluster weapon without one takes `cluster.warhead` (one submunition's).

massKg.description: Total launch mass of the weapon in kilograms (`M`, else `mass`, else the legacy `client` block).

subcategory.description: Optional wsType level 3 of `ws_type`/`wsTypeOfWeapon` (a weapon without its own wsType takes it with `category` from its exact-delivering launchers when they agree on it, `_source.subcategory: launcher`). Its meaning depends on `category` (level-3 numbers repeat across level 2), hence `subcategoryName`.

subcategoryName.description: Optional DCS constant name of `subcategory` among the level-3 constants Scripts/Database/wsTypes.lua lists for `categoryName` (for example `wsType_AA_Missile`, `wsType_Bomb_Guided`; tools/datamine/dcs_constants.py WEAPON_LEVEL3); absent when none carries the number (wsType_Bomb level 3 32 on the AO-2-5 and PTAB-2-5 submunitions).

className.description: Optional `class_name`: the DCS simulation class of the projectile (for example `wAmmunitionSelfHoming`, `wAmmunitionLaserHoming`, `wAmmunitionChangeableTrajectory`, `wAmmunitionNURS`).

scheme.description: Optional `scheme`: the DCS simulation scheme file the projectile runs (for example `schemes/missiles/aa_missile_semi_active.sch`, `schemes/bombs/bomb_jdam.sch`).

seekerType.description: Optional `Head_Type`, the seeker head type code of missiles and torpedoes (from the same-name `_G/rockets` record when the weapon's own lacks it, `_source.seekerType: rockets`).

seekerTypeName.description: Optional name of `seekerType` from tools/datamine/overlays.yaml `weapons/seekerTypes` (`InfraredSeeker`, `ActiveRadar`, `AntiRadar`, `LaserHoming`, `Autopilot`, `SemiActiveRadar`, `SemiAutoAT`: the engine constants the install's AJS37 weapon script quotes), `_source.seekerTypeName: hand-authored`; absent for codes no DCS source names (0 on torpedoes, 8 on command-guided SAMs).

seeker.description: Optional seeker parameters (`_source.seeker: rockets` when any comes from the same-name `_G/rockets` record).

rangeKm.description: Optional maximum range in kilometres: the first positive of `Range_max`, `D_max`, the largest cell of the `LaunchDistData` launch-range table (altitude x speed) and `dist_max` (unguided rockets' max range), missile fields read from the same-name `_G/rockets` record when the weapon's own lacks them (`_source.rangeKm: rockets`). DCS writes 0 for an unset range. Absent for weapons DCS gives no range: unguided and most guided bombs, and rockets whose `dist_max` is 0.

rangeField.description: Optional DCS field `rangeKm` was read from: `Range_max`, `D_max`, `LaunchDistData` or `dist_max`.

rangeMinKm.description: Optional minimum range in kilometres: `D_min`, else `dist_min` of a rocket with a positive `dist_max`.

rangeMinField.description: Optional DCS field `rangeMinKm` was read from: `D_min` or `dist_min`.

launchRangeMaxKm.description: Optional `D_max` in kilometres (annotated `-- max launch distance` in the install's AJS37 weapon script); it differs from `Range_max` on many missiles (air-to-air ones often below it).

rwrSymbol.description: Optional: the weapon's own RWR symbol in the install's AN_ALR_SymbolsBase.lua (active-radar missiles DCS shows on the RWR, e.g. AIM-54, PL-12, SD-10), joined exactly by projectile name or wsType; see tools/datamine/rwr.py.

alic.description: Optional: the weapon's distinct HARM/ALIC codes in the install's AN_ALR_HarmIDs.lua, joined like `rwrSymbol`, sorted numerically.

_source.description: Optional provenance map keyed by field path: `category`/`subcategory: launcher` when they come from the delivering launchers; `category: table` when it comes from membership of DCS's `bombs` table (wsType_Bomb); `rockets` on `seekerType`, `seeker`, `rangeKm`, `rangeMinKm` and `launchRangeMaxKm` when read from the weapon's same-name `_G/rockets` record (which must agree with its own on every field both carry); `seekerTypeName: hand-authored`; `warhead: cluster` when it is the cluster's. Absent fields are the weapon's own.

Entity.WsTypeWeaponLevel2.description: wsType level 2 under wsType_Weapon (`ws_type`/`wsTypeOfWeapon`), per Scripts/Database/wsTypes.lua. Not the scripting-API `Weapon.Category`. Generated by tools/datamine/extract.py from DCS constants (_G dump); do not edit.

Entity.LauncherCategory.description: Launcher/projectile `category` (CAT_*). Generated by tools/datamine/extract.py from DCS constants (_G dump); do not edit.

Entity.SensorCategory.description: Sensor `category` (SENSOR_*). Generated by tools/datamine/extract.py from DCS constants (_G dump); do not edit.

Entity.OpticSensorType.description: Optical sensor `type` (OPTIC_SENSOR_*). Generated by tools/datamine/extract.py from DCS constants (_G dump); do not edit.

Entity.RadarType.description: Radar sensor `type` (RADAR_*). Generated by tools/datamine/extract.py from DCS constants (_G dump); do not edit.

Entity.UnitRadarType.description: The wsType constants a ground vehicle's or ship's `WS.radar_type` takes. Generated by tools/datamine/extract.py from DCS constants (_G dump); do not edit.

Entity.RadioModulation.description: Radio `modulation` (MODULATION_*). Generated by tools/datamine/extract.py from DCS constants (_G dump); do not edit.

Entity.BeaconType.description: Beacon `type` (BEACON_TYPE_*), per Scripts/World/Radio/BeaconTypes.lua. Generated by tools/datamine/extract.py from the DCS install scripts; do not edit.

Entity.RadioModulationType.description: Terrain Radio.lua frequency modulation (MODULATIONTYPE_*), per Scripts/World/Radio/ModulationTypes.lua; not the aircraft-radio MODULATION_*. Generated by tools/datamine/extract.py from the DCS install scripts; do not edit.

Entity.FrequencyBand.description: Terrain Radio.lua frequency band key, per Scripts/World/Radio/FrequencyBands.lua. Generated by tools/datamine/extract.py from the DCS install scripts; do not edit.

Entity.StoreKind.description: Structural classification of a store, from the launcher `category` name (CAT_FUEL_TANKS, CAT_PODS, or a weapon category) or else the wsType in its `attribute`; weapon stores are `rack` when they carry more than one item or declare `Count = 0` (an empty rack or adapter). `unknown` when neither field is present.

Entity.Delivery.description: A weapon delivered by a store together with the quantity carried.

weapon.description: Cross-reference: `Entity.Weapon` id delivered by the store.

count.description: Number of this weapon carried by the store.

Entity.Fuze.description: A fuze option available for a store.

displayName.description: Optional DCS `dispName` of the fuze option, verbatim.

Entity.Store.description: A loadable store (pylon item), identified by its CLSID. Cross-references are string ids.

displayName.description: Human-readable store name shown in the loadout editor.

categoryName.description: Optional DCS constant name of `category` (for example `CAT_PODS`).

rack.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Rack` id if this store is mounted through a rack.

delivers.description: Weapons delivered by this store with their counts: the sum over the stores its `Elements[].payload_CLSID` load, else the projectile its `wsTypeOfWeapon`/`attribute` names, else the projectiles its element shapes match.

gunAmmo.description: Optional cross-references: `Entity.GunAmmo` ids a gun pod fires, from its `guns` shells (or those of the stores it loads).

aero.description: Aerodynamic and mass properties of the store.

fuzes.description: Fuze options available for this store.

fuelKg.description: Optional fuel capacity in kilograms for fuel-tank stores.

guns.description: Optional gun mounts: `gun_mounts`, else the `mounts` of the `weapons_table.aircraft_gunpods` entry whose `gunpod_name` is this CLSID (`_source.guns: aircraft_gunpods`).

sensors.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Sensor` ids of its `Sensors` table, else of the `db.Pods` entry whose `DisplayName` is this store's `displayName` (`_source.sensors: pods`).

picture.description: Optional `Picture`, the loadout editor image file.

_source.description: Optional provenance map keyed by field path: `guns`/`gunAmmo: aircraft_gunpods`; `sensors: pods`. Absent fields are the launcher's own.

required.description: Optional launcher `Required`: `Entity.Store` CLSIDs (each one asserted at extraction) DCS lists as needed elsewhere on the aircraft (e.g. a datalink pod), sorted. The mission editor does not enforce it.

Entity.StoreGun.description: One gun mount of a gun pod.

rates.description: Optional `gun.rates`, raw (rounds per minute by their values, e.g. M134 4000/2000).

Entity.Rack.description: A multiple-ejector or launch rack a store can be mounted through.

ejectors.description: Number of ejector or launch positions on the rack.

aero.description: Optional aerodynamic and mass properties of the rack.

attributes.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Attribute` ids describing this rack.

Entity.FormationPosition.description: A wingman offset in metres from the leader: x forward, y up, z right.

x.description: Forward offset.

y.description: Vertical offset.

name.description: Optional variant name (for example `Close (58 m x 48 m)`).

variants.description: DCS `variants`; else the single `positions` list; big formations: each named position set.

Entity.Aero.description: Aerodynamic and mass properties shared by aircraft, stores and racks; each kind fills a different subset, so every field is optional.

internalFuelKg.description: Maximum internal fuel capacity in kilograms.

maxSpeedKmh.description: Maximum speed in kilometres per hour.

massKg.description: Fixed mass in kilograms (stores and racks).

dragIndex.description: Aerodynamic drag index contribution when the entity is carried externally.

Entity.Position.description: Mounting offset of a station in the carrying aircraft's BODY frame (lateral/longitudinal/vertical, metres), unlike the world-frame `Vec3`.

lateral.description: Lateral (left-right) offset. Sign conventions vary by module and may be corrected per airframe during extraction.

Entity.YearRange.description: Inclusive service-year range during which an operator fielded an entity. An open-ended (still in service) range has no `to`.

to.description: Last year of service; absent while the entity is still in service.

Entity.Operator.description: A country that operates an entity, optionally with the years it was in service.

years.description: Optional service-year range, present when the dump includes the runtime `getYearsLocal` capture (`_G/__years__.lua`).

Entity.FreqRange.description: An inclusive radio frequency range in megahertz.

shape.description: Optional model name: `Shape` (aircraft), else `visual.shape` (ground vehicles, ships), else `ShapeName` (structures, personnel).

shapeDestroyed.description: Optional destroyed-model name: the first non-empty of `visual.shape_dstr`, `ShapeNameDestr`, `ShapeNameDstr`, `shape_table_data[1].desrt`.

lightsData.description: Optional `lights_data` (aircraft), the raw DCS table: nested `collection`s of lights with `connector`, `argument`, `typename` and `proto`.

animationArguments.description: Optional `animation_arguments` (ground vehicles, ships), the raw DCS table: names to model arguments, or to argument/value lists.

damageArgs.description: Optional model arguments of each `Damage` cell that names some (`Damage[cell].args`), sorted by cell.

canopyGeometry.description: Optional `CanopyGeometry`, raw: a number array (aircraft) or `{azimuth, elevation}` ranges (ground vehicles).

Entity.ModelArgValue.description: A model argument and its value (a Lua array's entries are arguments 1..n).

Entity.EncyclopediaChild.description: One `encyclopediaAnimation.children` entry: a model shown at a connector.

Entity.DamageCellArgs.description: The model arguments of one damage cell.

Entity.UnitLifeSource.description: The DCS field a unit life value comes from; each is on its own scale.

Entity.UnitLife.description: A life (hit points) value and the DCS field it comes from.

Entity.SensorEnvelope.description: A unit's `sensor` block: its target-finding envelope.

position.description: Optional `pos` `{x, y, z}` in the unit's model frame, metres.

Entity.UnitDetection.description: Detection, threat and signature values of a unit.

detectionRangeMax.description: Optional `detection_range_max` (aircraft), raw: DCS values mix scales (for example 70 and 400000).

rcsM2.description: Optional `RCS`, square metres (per the DCS unit files' own comment).

Entity.Transportable.description: `Transportable`: whether the unit can be carried as cargo.

size.description: Optional `size`, raw (unit not stated by DCS).

Entity.UnitCargo.description: Cargo capacity, transportability and towing of a unit.

nominalCapacity.description: Optional `InternalCargo.nominalCapacity`, raw (unit not stated by DCS).

maximalCapacity.description: Optional `InternalCargo.maximalCapacity`, raw (unit not stated by DCS).

Entity.ThreatKind.description: What a threat is: an air defence system firing missiles (`sam`) or only radar-directed guns (`aaa`), an early-warning radar (`ewr`), or a ship or aircraft on DCS's RWR tables.

Entity.ThreatEnvelope.description: An engagement envelope, in kilometres and metres: the launcher's own limits (`distanceMin`/`distanceMax`, `min_trg_alt`/`max_trg_alt` of its weapon systems, the widest across them), else the missile's (`D_min`/`D_max`, `H_min`/`H_max`).

rMinKm.description: Optional minimum engagement range in kilometres.

hMaxM.description: Optional maximum engagement altitude in metres.

hMinM.description: Optional minimum engagement altitude in metres.

Entity.ThreatComponent.description: A unit of a `sam`/`aaa` threat: one component per unit. Being a launcher is what `weapons` (with `envelope`) and `gunAmmo` (with `gunEnvelope`) say; `roles` holds only the unit's DCS attributes.

unit.description: Cross-reference: unit type id of the component.

roles.description: The unit's DCS role attributes among `SAM SR`, `SAM TR`, `SAM LL`, `SAM CC`, `SAM AUX`, `AAA` and `EWR`, in that order; nothing invented, so possibly empty (e.g. the M48 Chaparral launcher, which only `weapons` marks as one).

requires.description: Optional: the alternatives of the unit's `WS[i].LN[j].depends_on_unit` tables (WS/LN order, no repeats), each exactly as DCS writes it: a list of `{unit type or "self", weapon-system index?}` entries. The alternatives are any-of (DCS lists `{{"none"}}` as one for guns that may also fire unguided, e.g. flak18); every alternative in DCS data holds one entry.

weapons.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.Weapon` ids of the missiles the unit fires.

envelope.description: Optional (with `weapons`): envelope of the unit's missile weapon systems.

gunAmmo.description: Optional cross-reference: `Entity.GunAmmo` ids the unit fires.

gunEnvelope.description: Optional (with `gunAmmo`): envelope of the unit's gun weapon systems.

rwrSymbol.description: Optional: the unit's RWR symbol in the install's AN_ALR_SymbolsBase.lua.

alic.description: Optional: the unit's distinct HARM/ALIC codes in the install's AN_ALR_HarmIDs.lua, sorted numerically (a unit type can match by name and by a wsType it shares with another).

Entity.ThreatSystem.description: A threat: what DCS puts on an RWR (the install's AN_ALR_SymbolsBase.lua and AN_ALR_HarmIDs.lua, joined exactly by unit type or wsType), plus air defence systems firing without a radar. `sam`/`aaa` systems are Air Defence units linked by the missiles they fire and by `depends_on_unit`; see tools/datamine/extract_threats.py. Cross-references are stored as string ids.

id.description: Unique id from DCS data: a `sam` system's smallest missile name; an `aaa` system's smallest launcher unit type; otherwise the emitter's unit type.

natoDesignation.description: Optional NATO designation (e.g. `SA-11`) of the system's launchers and track radars, else its western system name (e.g. `Patriot`) or, for a system known only by its radar, that radar's NATO reporting name (e.g. `Dog Ear`); component units' own reporting names are `natoReportingName` on their records: from tools/datamine/overlays.yaml (by unit type) where DCS's NATO speech protocol (the install's Scripts/Speech/NATO.lua) does not name them or calls them by a non-formal name (`MANPADS`, `Zeus`), else the name NATO.lua calls them by; absent when they carry different names.

components.description: Optional (`sam`, `aaa`): the system's units, one component each, by unit type.

unit.description: Optional cross-reference (`ewr`, `ship`, `aircraft`): the emitter's unit type; its record holds the weapons.

world.VolumeType.description: Enumerator for 3D volume types used in spatial queries within the DCS World.

world.event.description: Enumerator for event types that occur during mission execution in the DCS World.

land.SurfaceType.description: Defines terrain surface types in the DCS World environment.

env.Mode.description: Enumerator for mission execution lifecycle states, used to determine the current operational phase of a mission in the DCS World environment.

Group.Category.description: Enumerator for group categories, used to classify different types of unit collections in the DCS World environment.

ControllerDetectedTarget.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a target detected by a controller, including its object reference and detection details.

object.description: Reference to the detected target object.

visible.description: Whether the target is currently visible via line of sight.

type.description: Whether the target's specific type is known to the detector.

distance.description: Whether the distance to the target is known to the detector.

ControllerDetectedTargetArray.description: Represents a numerically indexed Lua table (sequence) where each element is a table containing information about a detected target.

Controller.Detection.description: Enumerator for detection method types, used to specify or filter how controllers detect targets in the DCS World environment.

LiquidType.description: Enumerator for liquid fuel types, used to specify particular fuels within a `Warehouse` inventory.

AirbaseParking.description: Information about an airbase parking spot.

DCSAvailableSlotInfo.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing information about a player-controllable slot in a mission, including its unit ID, type, role, and other identifying data.

coalition.side.description: Enumerator for coalition sides, used to identify the different factions in the DCS World environment.

coalition.service.description: Enumerator for coalition service types, used to categorize radio communication services available to each faction.
